phase_policies.applies_when: At the start of the game, both players have limited information. The opponent's posture is unknown, and your own forces are still developing.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have more scouting information, such as seeing the opponent's first units or expansions. Exit this node when you have a clearer picture of the opponent's strategy.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and scouting, stay flexible, avoid overcommitment.
phase_policies.target: Maintain a balanced development path, focusing on economy and scouting. Avoid overcommitting to any single strategy until you have more information.
phase_policies.title: Balanced Development with Scouting
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single strategy without scouting information; avoid neglecting economy or scouting.

phase_policies.applies_when: As the game progresses into the early-mid game, you still have limited information about the opponent, but your own economy and production are starting to take shape.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have more scouting information or when the opponent's actions become clearer. Exit this node when you have a defined strategy.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and production, keep army flexible, scout for information.
phase_policies.target: Continue to develop your economy and production while keeping your army composition flexible. Focus on scouting to gain information about the opponent's plans.
phase_policies.title: Flexible Development with Scouting
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect scouting or overcommit to a single army composition without information.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the midgame, you have established a solid economic base, but the opponent's strategy is still unclear. You need to consolidate your position and prepare for potential conflicts.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or when they make a move. Exit this node when you have a clear strategic direction.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Consolidate economy, increase scouting, build defensive army.
phase_policies.target: Maintain your current development path while increasing your scouting efforts. Consider building a defensive army to protect your expansions and prepare for potential attacks.
phase_policies.title: Consolidate and Scout
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect scouting or fail to prepare defenses for your expansions.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the late midgame, you have a stable economy, but the opponent's strategy is still unknown. You need to prepare for the late game while maintaining flexibility.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have more scouting information or when the opponent's actions become clearer. Exit this node when you have a defined strategy.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and production, increase army, scout for information.
phase_policies.target: Continue to develop your economy and production while increasing your army size. Focus on scouting to gain information about the opponent's plans.
phase_policies.title: Prepare for Late Game
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect scouting or fail to increase army size in preparation for late game.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
